formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Variable Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C2.1 + C2.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can identify variables and find missing numbers.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can identify variables and find missing numbers.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Circle the variable in this equation: 8 + ☐ = 15.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. A single equation with a circle-the-symbol prompt.

image_placeholders.description: A single equation in B&W, ~5in x 1in. Pre-printed: '8 + ☐ = 15'. Header 'Circle the variable:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_VAR: keywords (circle, variable) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.prompt: Find the missing number in the addition equation: 12 + ☐ = 25.
prompts.visual_layout: Upper-middle. A single equation with an answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A single equation in B&W, ~5in x 1in. Pre-printed: '12 + ☐ = 25'. Below: 'My answer: ___'. Header 'Find the missing number:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_ADD: keywords (missing, number) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.prompt: Find the missing number in the subtraction equation: 30 - ☐ = 18.
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. A single equation with an answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A single equation in B&W, ~5in x 1in. Pre-printed: '30 - ☐ = 18'. Below: 'My answer: ___'. Header 'Find the missing number:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_SUB: keywords (missing, number) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, or TRY AGAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: variable circled + addition correct + subtraction correct = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Detective Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee with a Junior Detective certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Detective? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Detective!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'I identified variables', 'I found missing numbers in addition', 'I found missing numbers in subtraction', 'I found equivalent expressions', 'I solved a mystery case'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

options: I found missing numbers in addition
I found missing numbers in subtraction

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE detective task?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: variable symbol, addition equation, subtraction equation, equivalent expressions, mystery case. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Reading the variable', 'Subtraction missing-minuend', 'Finding many ways'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Bigger numbers', 'Multiplication mysteries', 'Two-variable equations'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5 after the certificate ceremony.
